meta.description: Canonical provider registry and evidence index for every sourced claim.
policy: Every sourced claim maps to exactly one provider. An unmatched source fails generation.
supportsAbsence identifies providers with complete scopes; only evidence URLs marked supportsAbsence=true are absence-capable. Provider authority alone never establishes absence.
Non-URL evidence is a named evidence class, never a fabricated hyperlink.
Duplicate URLs are canonicalized on scheme, host and path; query strings are preserved because several providers encode the language or card id there.

providers.licenseOrTerms: Publisher's own terms; used for identification and verification only.
providers.coverage: complete-manifest within the stated set or Prize Pack scope
providers.attribution: Official product checklists © The Pokémon Company International.
providers.notes: The only source permitted to establish that a finish is absent, and only inside its stated scope.

providers.licenseOrTerms: Publisher's own terms.
providers.coverage: Japanese-market cards and illustrators
providers.attribution: Japanese card data © The Pokémon Company.
providers.notes: Never returns Japanese secret/rainbow prints; their absence is not evidence.

providers.licenseOrTerms: Publisher's own terms.
providers.coverage: recent Traditional Chinese, Indonesian and Thai cards
providers.attribution: Asian card data © The Pokémon Company.
providers.notes: Recent releases only; older printings are out of coverage.

providers.licenseOrTerms: Open card database; see https://tcgdex.dev.
providers.coverage: card existence per language; positive normal/holo/reverse flags
providers.attribution: Card data from TCGdex.
providers.notes: Upstream documents its variant coverage as incomplete, so a false flag is never absence.

providers.licenseOrTerms: CC BY-NC-SA 2.5 — attribution and ShareAlike apply to derived content.
providers.coverage: set lists, release fields, per-language articles, promo series
providers.attribution: Content from Bulbapedia, licensed CC BY-NC-SA 2.5.
providers.notes: Tier 2 by owner decision, 2026-08-03. It sat at tier 3 beside retailer listings while carrying 247 of the 252 claims that rested on a single tier-3 source — more of this dataset than anything but TCGdex. The tier is meant to record dependability, and its contributors are dedicated researchers, so the rank now says what the project actually does with their work. Preferred for set release dates when the article identifies the matching market field. Korean and Chinese promo articles are {{incomplete}}-tagged; never contradict on their silence.

providers.licenseOrTerms: Redistributed TCGplayer catalogue data; see https://tcgcsv.com.
providers.coverage: product identity and positive Normal/Holofoil/Reverse Holofoil subtypes
providers.attribution: Product data via TCGCSV, sourced from TCGplayer.
providers.notes: Subtype omission is a catalogue gap, not proof a finish does not exist.

providers.licenseOrTerms: Site terms; used for identification only.
providers.coverage: named grading varieties for graded specimens
providers.attribution: Grading variety names from PSA.
providers.notes: Population counts and omissions are never used as negative evidence.

providers.licenseOrTerms: Site terms.
providers.coverage: one row per Asian market printing; Western printings lumped into a single English row
providers.attribution: Promo printing data from pokumon.com.
providers.notes: Indexes English names only. Absence never contradicts a Western language.

providers.licenseOrTerms: Site terms.
providers.coverage: Korean-market set and promo listings
providers.attribution: Korean printing data from koreanpokemoncards.com.
providers.notes: Declared before any claim cites it, so the research it is meant to start has a place to land. Prove it covers a category before reading its silence as evidence: rule 3 applies here as it does to pokumon, whose Western coverage is one lumped English row.

providers.licenseOrTerms: Forum terms; community-contributed content.
providers.coverage: promo language tables and the 1st-edition timeline within their stated scope
providers.attribution: Collector-community reference tables from Elite Fourum.
providers.notes: High-authority community reference, just below collection-owner authority. Its designated complete table is absence-capable within scope; other final absence decisions require a collection-owner adjudication. This capability is deliberate and pinned by verification/test_owner_adjudications.py; #66 questioned whether it sits well with rule 4, which admits only a complete official manifest, and left the decision with the owner. Nothing currently depends on it either way: all five units citing that thread also carry owner adjudications, so withdrawing it would move no row off not-printed.

providers.licenseOrTerms: Marketplace site terms.
providers.coverage: Brazilian/Portuguese market listings
providers.attribution: Marketplace listings from LigaPokemon.
providers.notes: Blocks datacenter IPs; retrieved through a residential browser session.

providers.licenseOrTerms: Site terms. Product images remain Cardmarket's; artwork remains the rights holders'.
providers.coverage: product catalogue, images, and marketplace availability
providers.attribution: Product catalogue and images via Cardmarket.
providers.notes: The catalogue over-claims languages — this is the finding the project exists to document. Never verification.

providers.licenseOrTerms: Open API; see https://pokemontcg.io.
providers.coverage: English-market illustrator credits and exact set release dates
providers.attribution: Illustrator and release data from pokemontcg.io.
providers.notes: English-market only.

providers.licenseOrTerms: Site terms.
providers.coverage: illustrator credits missing upstream from pokemontcg.io
providers.attribution: Illustrator data from Limitless TCG.
providers.notes: Named in the dataset's meta.artistSources for three cards missing upstream from pokemontcg.io, but no card row attributes to it individually - those rows carry the pokemontcg.io sourceType. Declared here so the gap is visible rather than implied.

providers.licenseOrTerms: Publisher's own terms.
providers.coverage: complete-manifest for the Prize Pack series it lists
providers.attribution: Prize Pack contents © The Pokémon Company International.
providers.notes: Official gallery of Prize Pack series contents; one of the few complete manifests here.

providers.licenseOrTerms: Individual retailer site terms; used for identification only.
providers.coverage: individual listings whose photography identifies an exact physical printing
providers.attribution: Retail listings from independent sellers.
providers.notes: Grouped deliberately: these are one-off listings, not catalogues, so per-host provider entries would imply a coverage guarantee none of them offers. A listing counts only when its image identifies the printing; stock photography does not.

providers.displayName: Internal derivation from a sibling record
providers.licenseOrTerms: This project's own inference; covered by the project data licence.
providers.coverage: attributes carried across records established to be the same card
providers.attribution: Derived within this project from an equivalent record.
providers.notes: Not an external source, and deliberately labelled so. Used where an attribute is carried from a sibling printing of the same card - for example an Additionals product reusing the base printing's illustrator. The underlying claim still rests on whichever provider sourced the sibling.

providers.licenseOrTerms: Contributed to this project; published as an anonymous evidence class.
providers.coverage: specimens physically held or inspected by the collection owner
providers.attribution: Owner attestation (domain expert), recorded anonymously.
providers.notes: Never rendered as a hyperlink. No personal identifiers are published.

providers.licenseOrTerms: Photographs of physical cards; depicted artwork remains the rights holders'.
providers.coverage: individual cards whose text and markings were read from a photograph
providers.attribution: Physical card, inspected specimen.
providers.notes: The strongest evidence class here: it defeated three databases at once on XYPR 179. Named for the act that is on the record. It was `photographed-specimen` until 2026-08-03, but no photograph is committed for any of the six specimens, so the label promised a file a reader could open and none existed. The recorded inspection is the evidence either way; rename it back once images land in verification/specimens/.

providers.licenseOrTerms: Seller photographs remain the seller's; depicted artwork remains the rights holders'.
providers.coverage: individual cards whose text and markings were read from a seller's listing photograph
providers.attribution: Seller listing photograph via Cardmarket.
providers.notes: Tier 2, below an owner-inspected specimen: the card text is legible, but it cannot be re-examined and the seller may have mislabelled the language. Record it as a SPEC-nnnn specimen with heldBy 'third-party seller' and the listing URL, never as a bare link — listings are deleted and the observation must outlive them. Positive evidence only: a listing's absence proves nothing, and the language filter above it is not evidence at all. No open API; collection is by hand or a browser session, subject to a rolling ~55-request quota before HTTP 429.
